feature.action_mapping_note: No exact action-name match; candidates are heuristic and require engine review.

intent.user_goal: Use Persistent Layout in a realistic Windows PowerShell workflow.
intent.transcript_requirement: Match this capability only when the video/transcript requires its visible interaction or result.
intent.when_to_use: Use when the observed UI behavior corresponds to Persistent Layout.
intent.when_not_to_use: Do not substitute a conceptually related feature without matching the visible interaction.

ui_contract.required_visibility: Lesson use must produce a visible software-owned UI state; hidden state mutation is insufficient.
ui_contract.before_state: Package baseline plus prior cumulative actions.
ui_contract.interaction: Inspect the simulator engine to determine the correct action.
ui_contract.after_state: The named surface/control/result must visibly reflect the interaction.
ui_contract.focus_and_scroll: Keep the active control/result visible without shaking.
ui_contract.highlight_rule: Highlight only the exact control/row/field/tab/code line/command/result.
ui_contract.explanation_rule: Use the single parent-owned global explanation card; never create a feature-specific explanation UI.

input_contract.parameters: Inspect the exact action handler before writing action.data; this file does not invent parameters.

state_contract.user_preferences: Persistent user layout/theme settings must survive replay unless explicitly changed.

transcript_matching.decision_rule: Match visible interaction + expected result, then verify the canonical action.

authoring_steps: Confirm the transcript visibly uses this feature.
Read this file, not only AI_CAPABILITY_INDEX.json.
Inspect the exact action handler for parameters.
lesson_authoring.missing_feature_rule: If the transcript requires behavior not supported here, upgrade the master simulator before creating the lesson.

replay_and_quality.visual_fidelity_note: Catalog coverage does not itself prove pixel-perfect visual fidelity.

maintenance.generated_baseline_note: Detailed baseline from current manifest and engine action surfaces; manual enrichment is allowed.
